name: Colombia
overview:
India and Gandhi. South Africa and Mandela. Colombia and Escobar. El Patron may not quite be in the same moral real as the other two, but much like them, his country’s story is incomplete without him.   

Three decades on from the terrors of the drug trade, Colombia has a long way in its healing journey. Medellin, the erstwhile epicentre of violence, has earned back its moniker as the city of eternal spring.   

Enough about the white powder, as there’s abundant magical realism to experience by simply being out and about in Colombia!
